criteria.detail: Constraints state 'Append-only branch. The branch tip only ever moves forward, by adding commits.'
Forbidden operations list 'git reset (any mode), git rebase, git commit --amend, and any history reordering.'
Bad commit is left in place and reported with a proposed follow-up commit that fixes forward, never reset/rebase/amend.
no forbidden sources cited, no git command output

judge_reasoning: The spec's Constraints carry the append-only rule verbatim, explicitly forbid all four rewrite operations, and route a redo through a left-in-place commit plus a proposed follow-up; all three criteria pass.
